one_sentence_story: Dropping volunteers 150 feet off a tower proved your eyes never speed up in a crisis, but scared memory packs extra detail so the moment feels 36 percent longer later.
so_what_for_you: In a highway skid, trust safe habits instead of super-vision. In daily life, try new weekend routes so fresh memories keep your years from flying by.
